description: React component for managing and displaying a list of channels with pagination, filtering, and auto-add toggle features in the admin console of Mattermost.

classes.name: ChannelList
classes.description: React component for listing channels with features like pagination, filtering, auto-add toggling, and removal in the admin console.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes state and sets up debounced search function.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets mounted flag and loads initial page.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cancels debounce and unsets mounted flag.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to search term and filters, triggers search or resets pagination.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of channels with optional page size.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of channels.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Loads the previous page of channels.

methods.name: getVisibleTotalCount
methods.description: Calculates total count including channels to add.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Returns pagination start, end, and total counts.

methods.name: removeChannel
methods.description: Marks a channel for removal and adjusts pagination if needed.

methods.name: handleAutoAddToggle
methods.description: Toggles auto-add status for a channel.

methods.name: getChannelAutoAddStatus
methods.description: Gets current auto-add status for a channel.

methods.name: getAllChannelsAutoAddStatus
methods.description: Determines if all visible channels are auto-added, not, or mixed.

methods.name: handleBulkAutoAddToggle
methods.description: Toggles auto-add status for all visible channels.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines columns for the data grid.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates rows for the data grid based on current channels and state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the channel list data grid with filtering, pagination, and controls.
